thread:
Samir (Sales): Pasting a customer ask from Fincorp — they want an "usage slice" builder in Console: interactive heatmap of cost vs latency over time, sliceable by model, route, and tenant. Need drill-down to request traces and CSV export. They say current per-tenant views are too coarse and ops can't find which routes caused cost spikes. Screenshot + slack thread attached: https://acme.example/snap.png
Elena H: thanks Samir. quick q — do they need this in hosted only or for Dedicated/Private too?
Samir (Sales): Primary ask is hosted customers (they use our hosted API). Later they might want on-prem, but initial ask = hosted. Priority: high for them, they'd consider enterprise contract add-on.
Kevin (PM): can we get a one-paragraph expected workflow from the customer? e.g., "select tenant -> pick date range -> split by model/route -> click cell -> see trace list -> export". That helps scope.
Samir (Sales): Sent a small sketch and a priority note — I'll paste below when they reply.
Miguel R: fwiw, UX-wise we could reuse per-route widgets but need a heatmap component and an interactive filter. Should be doable as Console UI work + telemetry backend query.
Ashok (Eng): backend concerns: we currently store per-request annotations (model, route, tenant) in telemetry, but trace links are only kept for 7 days. Customer needs 30d retention for heatmap. That is a storage + retention policy ask. Also heavy cross-aggregation by model+route could be expensive — need pre-agg or approximate counters.
Kevin (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: 1) heatmap in Console showing cost (token-cost) vs p95 latency by day 2) filters: tenant, model, route, timeframe 3) clicking a cell lists requests with trace links 4) CSV export of visible rows 5) works for 30d window (hosted). Any objections?
Elena H: add: link-to-trace should include model/version and request_id, and export should include cost breakdown per request.
Miguel R: implementation idea: create a nightly pre-agg job that emits daily per-tenant per-model per-route summaries to our analytics store, and wire Console to that for the heatmap. Drill-down can query raw events for that bucket (bounded by 30d). This avoids scanning raw logs on UI load.
Ashok (Eng): estimate: backend + API ~ 3-4 wks, Console heatmap + filters ~ 2wks, export + trace linking ~ 1wk. If we build pre-agg infra now it helps other features.
Kevin (PM): scope negotiation: MVP should support 30d, daily granularity, and a single export format. We can postpone per-tenant role-based views and Dedicated deployment work for later. That keeps initial delivery tighter.
Samir (Sales): Customer says 30d daily is fine for MVP. They consider real-time (minute-level) a future ask.
observability-bot: Note: there is an existing dashboard scaffold at /dashboards/telemetry/heatmap-template (internal) that includes widgets for latency+cost.
Kevin (PM): risks: cost of pre-agg storage + query cost. Need cost estimate and potential billing implications. Also need to confirm trace retention extension (policy + cost).
Ashok (Eng): action items: - confirm storage cost with infra (Miguel) - design pre-agg schema and retention options (Ashok) - Console UX mockups (Elena) - sales/customer success draft SLA/commit language (Samir)
Miguel R: I'll ping infra for storage cost estimate today.
Elena H: I'll whip up a grayscale mock and share tomorrow.
Samir (Sales): I'll consolidate customer sketch + use cases into a short doc and share with product and eng by EOD.
Kevin (PM): prioritization ask: this maps to "observability / billing" theme. If infra cost is reasonable, let's target a 6-week sprint for MVP starting next roadmap cycle. If infra costs are high, we may shift to a phased rollout (heatmap UI + pre-agg for cost only -> later latency p95).
Ashok (Eng): noted. For triage ticket I'll open a JIRA: INF-5467 and link this thread.
Samir (Sales): :thumbsup: thanks all.
Elena H: :eyes: will post mocks here when ready.
Kevin (PM): leaving this open until we have infra estimate and mock. Owner: Kevin.
